title: Giant skull carried by an excavator and his wife

tellings.quote: It was so large that he and his wife had to carry it together and they brought it into the church.

plain: Some time between 1978 and 1981, near Santa Anastasia on the Italian island of Sardinia, an excavator worker found a skull so large that he and his wife had to carry it together, and they brought it into the church. A guest named Tim Alberino tells it, passing on what he was told, without naming the man. He offers it as evidence that giants once lived there.
